title: Updating Architecture Quiz Wording
description: Add the render-independent declarative quiz product (framework/products/quiz), the teaching domain with the proctor server (sqlite-backed CQRS/event-sourced user, run, score, badge and leaderboard tracking) and the first architecture/energy quizzes (physics, heating, cooling, energy demand) for quizze.architektur-und-technologie.de: onboarding (introduction, anonymous/pseudonym/name identity without password), randomized presentation, whole-run submission, partial-credit scoring with rank-distance metrics for numerical sortings, badges and a leaderboard. Reopened 2026-09-29: the UI becomes a card grid like semio-tech play and the mit-bestand demonstrator with the leaderboard as the central card; the proctor is zero-touch deployable on Docker under proctor.quizzes.architektur-und-technologie.de and the client is a static site distributed over a CDN at quizzes.architektur-und-technologie.de. Reopened again 2026-09-29: the quizzes page must be multilayered like semio-tech play — the content of every card rendered behind the glassy layer, and hovering a card shows its page clear. Reopened 2026-09-29 (night): presence shared within the quizzes — learners see what the others think (live draft answers, crowd of submitted answers, cursors on items); the home backdrop shows the real live subpages as a grid (presence inside them, live leaderboard). Reopened 2026-10-02 (overview camera): the overview of a quiz page is a 2D map of its pages whose camera follows the cursor in the background like semio-tech play and the mit-bestand demonstrator, with every page always visible in the overview. Reopened 2026-10-02 (crowd after submission): by default the results of the others show only after a quiz is submitted; the learner can explicitly ask to see the distribution before; everything about the others is plotted (answer distributions per item, score distributions). Reopened 2026-10-02 (overview exactly like play): two layers as on semio-tech play and the mit-bestand demonstrator — fixed cards on a grid in front, the screen-sized pages behind the glass; the background moves under the glass while the mouse is between the cards, and hovering a card brings its page to the screen, crisp. Reopened 2026-10-02 (overview frozen): the background must move between the cards also in the owner's Remote Desktop session, whose browsers report reduced motion.
summary: Expanded the terminology update throughout the German power-vs-work classification: quiz description, question title, prompt, category label, and annual-quantity explanations now use Arbeit. Added/retained catalog assertions for title, prompt, and category. Direct content assertion passed. The architecture-quiz suite passed 235 tests before concurrent schema edits; the latest rerun during those changes failed on unrelated validation errors in the in-progress quiz content (missing required quantity.additive fields). See 📓️german-power-work-wording.md.
